messages.author: c2f125e6a2bec0f9
messages.subject: Re: cross_info matrix file for Collaborative Cross (CC) or risib8
parts:
Hi Chenhan,

I guess what you are looking for are the funnel codes of the CC which are in Table S2 from Srivastava et al. PMID:28592495
Note that there are missing funnel codes for strains which genealogy is not know.
For these ones, look at the discussion below with Karl :

For 8-way RIL by sibling mating ("risib8"), it matters which are in the 4th, 7th, and 8th slots, because they won't show up on the X chromosome, but also what is in the 3rd slot, because that should be represented with probability 1/3, vs 1/6 each for 1st, 2nd, 5th, and 6th.

It would be nice to work this out once and for all, for the CC lines. It also be nice to have genotype probabilities pre-calculated for the CC lines, so that others may make use of them.

karl

On 1/28/19 3:28 AM, Xavier Montagutelli wrote:

Hi Karl,

I am trying to analyze CC data with rqtl2. It seems I have to provide an 8-letter code for each CC (funnel code) as cross_info.

Funnel codes are available for most, but not all strains, probably for track records issues.

I suppose the main use rqtl2 does with these funnel codes is the inheritance of X-linked alleles.

 

In a CC strain, X-linked alleles never come from the 4th, 7th and 8th parents of the funnel code.

For each CC, I must exclude from these position any parental allele found at X-linked loci.

Would any funnel code fitting this condition work equally for the analysis ?

Thanks,

Xavier
